acceptanceCriteria: A decision records whether creation/retirement ownership can be proven and by what mechanism.
If adopted, a test fails when a leader group not created by the parent Owner is enabled.
The spec's known-limit text is updated or removed accordingly.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, origin/main 8a3e3a5b. The c443 transport adapter's gitstatus.EnableOwnedWorker proves only process-group leadership of the worker, not that the parent Owner created or will retire the group. This is a known limit recorded in docs/specs/aggregate-local-outcome-v0.md (PR #524), which is not in the local checkout at this base, so the symbol was not re-verified here. Expected: ownership evidence binds the group to its creating Owner and its retirement path. Actual: leadership only. Idea: define what proof would close the limit and whether it is worth the cost.
title: c443 transport adapter gitstatus.EnableOwnedWorker proves only process-group leadership, not parent Owner creation or retirement
